name: get_email_messages
description: Fetch full-fidelity Gmail messages that match a Gmail query. No importance/summarizer filtering is applied.

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: Maximum matched messages to return (default 25, max 200).

inputs.name: include_body
inputs.description: Whether to include parsed body text (default true).

inputs.name: include_headers
inputs.description: Whether to include normalized RFC headers (default true).

outputs.description: Matched messages with metadata and optional full body/headers.

metadata.planner_description: Fetch full Gmail messages matching a query (body + headers).
